fields.statement: At fd3f4b3 I built rhiza to a scratch path and, in a scratch repo, ran a one-step workflow that fails: run start exited 1 and rhiza inbox listed the failed run with next 'rhiza run resume --retry'. rhiza run abandon <run> exited 0; run status showed 'Run ... failed' with 'Detail: abandoned by darin-haener', and --json gave state failed, detail 'abandoned by darin-haener'. rhiza inbox then said 'Nothing waits on you' and inbox --json gave items []. run resume and run resume --retry each exited 2 with 'run <id> was abandoned'; a second abandon exited 2 with 'is finished: it failed'. After making the step pass, a succeeded run's abandon exited 2 with 'is finished: it succeeded'.

At fd3f4b3, with the built binary in a scratch repo, I failed a real run on each of four change sets, so rhiza inbox listed four failed runs. I then landed one change set, withdrew one and rejected one, and left the fourth as a draft. rhiza inbox and inbox --json then listed only the failed run on the draft change set. rhiza inbox open on the withdrawn change set's item exited 2 with 'no inbox item'. I did not reproduce the gave-up and superseded cases by hand. They and the question/sign-off cases pass in inbox-stale.txtar, which I ran with run-abandon-failed and the other inbox and run-abandon scripts (go test -count=1, ok).
